title: Jack Carey as best routine band and dances on the lake
summary: Williams calls Jack Carey's band the best routine band; he played three times a week on the lake, where every club had a band.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: What were some of the best routine of bands that you ever heard?
Well, I tell you, old Jack Carroll's the best routine band I heard. He's a good routine band.
Yes, I heard you. They had him, Zep, his brother. Who else? On bass. Old Tabla and Kato played bass with him too. They didn't keep no one bunch of color all the time. They changed up.
What's Tabs for it? Full line? Tab-a-line?

Yeah, Tab-a-line. Tab-a-line Kato. They used to play a piano by a routine, though. Then he took that bass ball. See, out on that lake, we used to do good on the lake. I used to play it three times a week out on the lake. I used to play it. Because I had dances often right back on the lake. Where did I made land? There used to be water.
Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Near that, like at the lighthouse out there? Is that the project? Yeah. Millenburg?
Yeah. Used to be good time out there.
How many bands would they have out there?
Four or five bands. Every club had a band. Dancing going on. All the time. He used to have a little train running back to something and all that and going out to the lake.
